source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Jessica,

Thanks for bearing with us until we share the contract — to keep things clean on our end, we'll hold off on sharing the editable or downloadable document until the contract is finalized. Once terms are settled, we'll send over the PDF so you can start working ahead.

We wanted to reiterate the scope of work that we plan on including in the contract:

**1\. Addition of chapters (5, as discussed earlier)**

A. Basic chapters (not question & answers & should be within the range of 2.5k - 3.5k or less)

\--Pre-interview preparation checklist — since this audience already has experience, this chapter may need a leadership-specific angle rather than the basics. If there are tips especially relevant to leadership-level interviews, we'd love to include those.

\--How to use AI for interview preparation (prompts, techniques, tools)

B. Question & Answers chapters (The author is free to add as many questions to each of the following chapters as they want while keeping in mind the total word count of the book.)

\--Questions candidates can ask the interviewer

\--Questions specifically geared toward first-time leaders

\--Remote & Hybrid Leadership questions

**2\. Reviewing the existing content and updating it (Based on the earlier discussions, you have agreed to review and update the content according to the instructions.)**

\--Streamlining the question set for each chapter (category) present in the current edition (or from the 250 questions). The author is free to suggest the following (these are all the options that the author can use to deliver the best content):

1\. Remove a particular category or merge two categories (chapters).

2\. Remove certain questions after providing a rationale for the same.

3\. Add new questions to the particular category (to update the edition with the questions that are being asked in the current workplace)

4\. Add a new category of questions (if it has not been covered already)

5\. If the author feels that some questions could be rephrased and used in a better way, they are free to suggest that as well.

\--Developing answers & adding answers for the new questions (as discussed: 2 mandatory and 2 subjective)

1\. Mandatory answer layers: How to frame the answers (answer frameworks are to be integrated in this) and a sample answer.

2\. Subjective answer layers: Interviewer’s intent & common mistakes

Please note that any addition (category/chapter or questions) or removal (category/chapter or questions) will be subject to proper review by the editorial team before being implemented. As discussed earlier, the author will be reviewing the book (all 250 questions) and sharing their feedback with the team in the first milestone.

**3\. Hybrid resources**

\--All our books aim to offer readers a hybrid learning experience, since not everyone wants to read cover-to-cover. Alongside the book, we'd like to offer companion online resources — checklists, AI prompts, videos on body language, mock interviews, answer templates, leadership resume tips, or any other ideas you might have.

The overall word count of the book should be 50k. So, the author should stay within that word count limit and plan the content around it.

The author is free to suggest any other revisions or additions they think would make the book highly relevant or interactive to the current audience. However, the implementation of those ideas will happen after a discussion with the editorial team.

\-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Please confirm that you are clear on the above requirements for this project and are okay with moving ahead.

Regarding the contract, our team is finalizing the contract, and we’ll be sharing it with you soon for your review.

Thank you for your patience! We look forward to working with you on this project and getting started as soon as possible.
